title: Climate
description: The calendar the weather kinds are drawn against and the globals every kind shares, per docs/adr/0016-weather-kinds-and-seasons.md. One entry ships (climate.temperate) and SimWeather reads it by path (climate/temperate.json). Not a second calibration entry on purpose: the frozen TypeScript oracle validates calibration/ against the attention schema with Ajv and would refuse it, while it does not know this directory and ignores it, exactly as it ignores weather/. NOTE: the content validator is shallow -- check_m2_weather.gd's CONTENT lane holds the inner shape (four seasons in order, the drying timings ordered, the cover threshold inside (0, 1)).

id.description: Stable namespaced id. Permanent once shipped.

seasonDays.description: In-game days a season lasts. 5: a ten-day run sees two seasons (the owner's call, 2026-09-06).

seasonOrder.description: The four seasons in the order the calendar cycles through them, starting from startSeason on day 1.

wetAfterTicks.description: How long a body stands in a wetting kind before it counts as wet. Ten seconds at 20 Hz for the shipped 200.

dryAfterTicks.description: How long a wet body stays wet once out of it with no fire. An hour for the shipped 12000.

dryByFireTicks.description: How long a wet body takes to dry within a lit campfire's heat. Twelve minutes for the shipped 2400; must be below dryAfterTicks or the fire is no help.

windDriftDays.description: How often, in days, the wind re-rolls its direction on the weather stream.

windStrength.description: How hard the wind leans the scent diffusion, before a kind's windMul: the attention field's four neighbour weights are 1 +/- windX and 1 +/- windY, normalised. 0.6 matches the strength the field used to be fixed at.

meltPerTick.description: How much snow cover (0..1) melts a tick while no snow falls. Twelve hours from full cover to bare ground for the shipped value.

snowCoverMoveMul.description: The global move_speed multiplier on every living body while the cover is at or above snowCoverThreshold.

snowCoverThreshold.description: The cover at which snow underfoot starts to slow the living.
